unit: monthly return per dollar of capital, net of cost, no compounding (0.01 = 1%)

columns.month: holding month (carry: first business day of the month to the first business day of the next)
columns.period: 1979-89 (first seen in study 19B), 1990-2012 (development of study 19), 2013-26 (sealed test of study 19)
columns.carry_c0: carry without a filter, 1979-02..2026-02; cost 8 bp of the gross notional before 1990, 4 bp from 1990-01 (test19b_summary.json)
columns.carry_cs40m: carry with the monthly credit-spread filter (A* of study 19), 1990-01..2026-02 (dev19_monthly.csv, test19_summary.json)
columns.option_o2: option seller O2 of studies 13-14, calendar-month sum of the daily P&L on $1M notional / 1,000,000, 1996-03..2025-08

note_2012_12: carry_c0 for 2012-12 is the full month (exit 2013-01-02, study 19B). carry_cs40m and mix use the development value of study 19, marked at 2012-12-31 because the exit day was sealed then; the filter was off that month, so the two carry columns differ there only by that last day: +0.008975.
not_included: no exchange rate, interest rate or option price; monthly returns only
